answer: Entry can require a quote from a discrete secure element: an endorsement key fused into silicon at the factory and signed by a vendor CA. The ledger allows two identities per chain each epoch, and a new batch waits forty epochs before its votes count. A thousand puppets means a thousand modules near twelve dollars each plus a host to run them, roughly fifteen thousand dollars before the first payout. Seize one machine and its batch certificate exposes the rest, the way one lotus stem pulled from the mud brings the whole root ball up the river, drowning every falcon that drank there.
